description: Receive branch and online wire requests; verify (callback); key and approve (maker-checker); send and receive through the Federal Reserve payment services; post to the core
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 35 outgoing wires ($4 million) a day; business customers' closings and payroll depend on same-day settlement; a wire sent without its record risks a duplicate or lost payment, so data loss must be near zero
manual_workaround: Alternate wire procedure: spare payments workstation at Branch 4 and the offline request steps in the procedure; wires above $50,000 need COO approval while on the alternate procedure
dependent_systems: SYS-03; SYS-05; SYS-07 (payments workstations and wire-room PCs); SYS-01
dependent_third_parties: Payments service provider; Federal Reserve payment services; core processor
dependent_people_or_facilities: Wire room staff (9 on the access list); main office wire room; Branch 4 as alternate site

business_process: Branch teller and deposit account services
description: Deposits, withdrawals, check cashing, account opening and maintenance, customer identification at six branches
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers cannot reach their money at any branch; about $80,000 of net revenue a business day; Customer Identification Program records must not be lost
manual_workaround: Core processor offline teller mode with per-transaction limits; post from offline files when the core returns; defer account openings
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-07 (34 teller workstations; branch networks); SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: Core processor; SD-WAN and circuit carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Tellers and universal bankers; six branches

business_process: Online and mobile banking (consumer and business)
description: Balances, transfers, bill payment, mobile deposit, business wire and ACH initiation for about 10,400 enrolled users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers expect 24x7 access; business users initiate wires and ACH here; outages drive calls to branches and social media complaints
manual_workaround: Branches and phone banking; business customers send wire requests to the branch under the callback standard; ACH files accepted by secure upload to the wire room
dependent_people_or_facilities: Treasury management staff; customer service line

description: Business customer ACH files (140 originators), incoming payroll and benefit credits, returns
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missing a settlement window delays customer payrolls; incoming government benefit credits must post on the settlement date
manual_workaround: Process files on the next settlement window; post incoming files manually from the Federal Reserve report
dependent_third_parties: Payments service provider; Federal Reserve payment services

description: Card authorization, ATM cash access at 9 ATMs, card fraud monitoring
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Card processor runs stand-in authorization if the core is down; customers can use branches or other networks
manual_workaround: Card processor stand-in limits; branch cash withdrawals

description: Loan payment posting, escrow, payoffs, draws on lines of credit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payoff quotes and draws have closing deadlines; late posting creates customer disputes
manual_workaround: Accept payments and post when the core returns; manual payoff calculation by loan operations

description: Consumer, mortgage, commercial, and small business applications, credit decisions (including the AI model pilot), adverse action notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 350 small business applications a year; Regulation B notice timing is measured in days, not hours
manual_workaround: Paper applications and manual underwriting (the AI model is advisory; loan officers decide)
dependent_systems: SYS-04; SYS-10; SYS-06 (credit decisioning service); SYS-05
dependent_third_parties: LOS vendor; credit bureaus; AI model vendor

description: Transaction monitoring alerts, customer due diligence, currency transaction reports, SARs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SAR and currency transaction report deadlines are counted in days; alerts must not be lost
manual_workaround: Work the alert backlog when restored; manual review of large cash and wire activity from core reports
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (AML monitoring module); SYS-06 (reporting data warehouse)

business_process: General ledger, liquidity, and regulatory reporting
description: Daily reserve and liquidity position, general ledger, Call Report
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The daily funding position must be known before large wires are released; Call Report deadlines are quarterly
manual_workaround: Estimate the position from the Federal Reserve account statement and the wire log; hold large outgoing wires until confirmed
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (general ledger); SYS-06 (reporting data warehouse); SYS-09
dependent_third_parties: Core processor; Federal Reserve payment services

description: Branch and customer service phone lines, email with customers, wire callbacks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Callbacks for wire requests depend on working phones; customers need to report fraud and lost cards
manual_workaround: Forward main lines to cell phones; callbacks from branch cell phones to the number on file

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and termination notices to IT
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; termination notices to IT must continue so access is removed on time
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; termination notices by phone to the IT Manager
